response.sql: SELECT a.link_to_member AS member_id, m.position AS position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM attendance a INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Ties in share at the 10-group cutoff are broken arbitrarily since the request gives no tiebreaker; LIMIT 10 returns exactly 10 groups.
The share denominator is the sum of counts across all groups after dropping unmatched records (computed before LIMIT), as the request specifies.
